questions.question: Identify the disease caused by a monkey bite.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Rabies.__**

__**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabies** is a **preventable viral disease** most often transmitted through the **bite of a rabid animal**. 
 
• The **Rabies virus** infects the central nervous system of mammals, ultimately causing disease in the brain and death
 
• **Risks from monkey bites** include serious wound infections, **herpes B virus and rabies**. if a person is bitten the wound should be thoroughly cleaned with soap and water.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Malaria** is a serious and sometimes fatal disease caused by a parasite that commonly infects a certain type of mosquito which feeds on humans

 
 
• ​People who get malaria are typically very sick with high fevers, shaking chills, and flu-like illness.
 
• Four kinds of malaria parasites infect humans: *Plasmodium falciparum*, *P. vivax*, *P. malariae*, *P. ovale*.
 
 
 
• **Typhoid** fever is a bacterial infection that can spread throughout the body, affecting many organs. 
 
 
• ​Without prompt treatment, it can cause serious complications and can be fatal.
 
• It is caused by a bacterium called *Salmonella typhi*, which is related to the bacteria that cause salmonella food poisoning.
 
 
 
• **Influenza** is a contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses that infect the nose, throat, and sometimes the lungs.
 
 
• ​ It can cause mild to severe illness, and at times can lead to death. The best way to prevent flu is by getting a flu vaccine each year.

• **The female mosquitoes **travel in the** swarms to mate with some Anopheles male mosquitoes which often occur at dusk.****** ****

• With the** exception of Antarctica**, **Anopheles mosquitoes** are** present almost everywhere**.
 
• **Anopheles mosquitoes** spread the** parasite disease malaria.**
 
• **Malaria is a parasitic infection transmitted by Anopheline mosquitoes**.

• There are many different places where you can find water, such as puddles, creeks, ditches, ornamental ponds, horse troughs ,unmaintained swimming pools and marshy areas.
 
• **Single eggs** are laid by female **Culex mosquito.**

• The **golden rule of chess **is a piece is safe only as long as it is defended by the same number of pieces that are attacking it.
 
• If your opponent attacks one of your pieces, count the number of your pieces that defend it immediately to make sure that it is safe.
 
• The **fifty-move rule **in chess states that a player can claim a draw if no capture has been made and no pawn has been moved in the last fifty consecutive moves.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan Kumudini Lakhia is a _________ dancer.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Kath****ak.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumudini Lakhia**** **is an Indian Kathak dancer and choreographer based in **Ahmedabad, Gujarat.**
 
• She founded** Kadamb School of Dance and Music, an institute of Indian dance music in 1967.**
 
• She started her career** dancing with Ram Gopal.​​ **
 
• **Bharata natyam, kathakali, manipuri, kuchipudi, and odissi **are among the major Indian classical dance-dramas, along with kathak, which is one among them. Native to northern India, **Kathak was shaped by both Muslim and Hindu **cultural influences.** **
 
• **One of the eight primary **styles of Indian classical dance is **kathak.** It is the traditional dance of **Uttar Pradesh.** The origins of Kathak are frequently attributed to the travelling storytellers or bards known as **Kathakars in ancient northern India.**** **​
 
• **Awards**:
 
 
• Padma Shri in 1987
 
• Padma Bhushan in 2010
 
• Padma Vibhushan (posthumously) in 2025.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kumudini **learned first from various gurus of** Jaipur Gharana**, and then from **Shambhu Maharaj.**
 
• Kumudini was the name of the mother of** Rai Bahadur Ranada Prasad Shaha.**
 
• The world-famous Kathak dancer,** Pandit Birju Maharaj** is the face of the Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Lucknow.

ed:T
